- **Work in a separate git worktree (task/PSI-006) instead of the main folder**: Another agent session owns PSI-002 and has uncommitted edits in the main tree; switching branches or committing there would disturb it (alternatives: Wait for the PSI-002 session to finish; Take over PSI-002 in the shared tree)
- **Change only package.json; leave the two scripts as they are**: They already met the accept line when run. A ponytail review suggested shrinking scripts/agent-context.ts, but the accept line and contract C-16 require agent-context --check, so it stays (alternatives: Replace agent-context.ts with a one-line cat script)

- Merge conflict expected in docs/list-task-project.md: the main tree carries an uncommitted 'PSI-006 doing' edit that the PSI-002 branch may commit; resolve by keeping PSI-006 at review (or done once a human approves)
